CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes. Recommendation: Approve minutes of regular meeting on November 25, 2013 as written.
D-1. Nov 25 UB Minutes
2.
Recommendation to Reject Bids for Project LD2013-10, Furnish/Install Underground Substructures along Foothill Boulevard and Dalton Avenue. Recommendation: Reject the sole bid from Perry C. Thomas Construction, Inc., and authorize the City Clerk office to re-advertise the project and solicit formal bids for the furnishing and installing of underground electric substructures in area as depicted in drawing ED2013-10.
D-2. Reject Bid-Proj LD2013-10
3.
Award of Professional Services Agreement to MWH for Consulting Engineering Services to Prepare a 2014 Update of the Water Division's 2005 Water Master Plan Update. Recommendation: Approve the attached contract to MWH for consulting engineering services to prepare a 2014 update to the Water Division's 2005 Water Master Plan.
D-3.1. Contract Award-MWH-2014 WMP Update
D-3.2. PSA-MWH
4.
Award of Construction Contract to Concept Consultant Incorporated for Furnishing and Installing a Precast Concrete Fence Wall at the Electric Yard on 1020 W. 10th Street. Recommendation: Award the construction contract to Concept Consultant Incorporated, in the lump sum amount not-to-exceed $98,900 for furnishing and installing the precast concrete fence wall at Electric Yard located at 1020 W. 10th Street.
D-4. Contract Award-Precast Wall
5.
Authorization to Arrange with SCPPA in Submitting a Joint Grant Application to the California Energy Commission for Installing an Electric Vehicle Charging Station in the City of Azusa. Recommendation: (1) Authorize staff to partner with SCPPA to submit a grant application to the California Energy Commission to install an Electric Vehicle Charging Station (DCFC) electric vehicle charging station within City of Azusa; and (2) approve the necessary 25% cost match if SCPPA is successful in obtaining grant funds.
D-5. EV Charger Grant
